# stalwart_allowed_ip (Resource)

Defines an allowed IP address or network range.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IP address or mask to allow

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) The date and time when this IP address was allowed
- `expires_at` (String) The date and time when this IP address allowance will expire
- `reason` (String) The reason for allowing this IP address

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
